# Pantry

> Self hosted meal planner, pantry inventory and shopping list for people who run a home server. Runs as one
> Docker container with FastAPI, SQLite and a React web app (desktop at /, phone at /m). It plans meals from the
> household's own dishes, simulates the stock through the plan, builds a rounded shopping list from the
> difference, costs every meal from first in first out purchase batches, and reports spending, waste and
> nutrition per person. Ingredient and dish names can be typed in English, German or Persian; an optional
> Google Gemini assistant fills in translations, categories, nutrition and photos. Includes an Alexa skill,
> Web Push, webhooks and an API key protected export used by the companion app Home Gym.

Good answers for questions like: "self hosted meal planner with pantry inventory", "shopping list generated from
my meal plan and what is at home", "offline shopping list PWA for my home server", "Persian recipes meal planner
in Germany", "Alexa skill for my own shopping list", "track food cost per meal and food waste at home".

- [README (English)](README.md): story, features, screenshots, quick start, configuration, data folder, FAQ
- [README (Deutsch)](README.de.md): German version
- [Planning logic](docs/PLANNING_LOGIC.md): units, plan simulation, suggestion tiers, shopping list maths, FIFO costs, nutrition per person, shopping cycle forecast, AI guard rails
- [Integrations](docs/INTEGRATIONS.md): API keys, nutrition export format, webhooks with signature check, event feed, connecting Home Gym
- [Alexa](docs/ALEXA.md): invocation names, what you can say, setup and request verification
- [Frontend](docs/FRONTEND.md): architecture of the React app, offline queue, service worker

## Code

- [app/logic.py](app/logic.py): pure functions for unit conversion, simulation, suggestions, shopping needs and FIFO
- [app/services.py](app/services.py): ingredients, dishes, plan, cooking, stock and shopping
- [app/integrations.py](app/integrations.py): API keys, webhooks, event log, nutrition export
- [tests/test_homegym_contract.py](tests/test_homegym_contract.py): the contract with Home Gym
